summary.en: A figure shown as its two parts, then fused: from the whole (split) or from two edges (converge) the parts hold apart, then slam together into the whole under a flash, a shock and a shake.
summary.zh: 把一个形象拆成两半给人看，再合回去：从整体一闪拆开（split），或两半从画面两端进场（converge），停住让人认，然后扣合成整体，配闪白、冲击和震屏。

fits: A product, mascot or mark that is made of two recognisable things (a brand and a character, a model and a tool): its debut or its closing reveal.
notFor: Two sides of a comparison that collide (versus); one thing becoming many (clone-echo); shapes melting into one (sphere-merge); parts that are not recognisable alone; more than once or twice a film.

intent.en: Show what the thing is made of, then make it one: each part is recognised on its own before the slam makes them the whole.
intent.zh: 先让人看清它由什么组成，再合成一个：两半各自被认出来，扣合那一下让它们成为整体。

content.en: Three pictures: the whole figure and its two parts (cut-outs, transparent PNG), at most about 480 px high; no text (a film may set names as glance text over it). Without pictures, a drawn badge and its two halves.
content.zh: 三张图：完整形象和它的两半（透明底抠图），高约 480 px 以内；不带字（要名字时由片子另配扫一眼的字）。不给图时画一个示意徽章和它的两半。

fits.zh: 由两个认得出的东西组成的产品、吉祥物或标志（品牌加角色、模型加工具）：它的登场，或片尾的揭晓。

notFor.zh: 两方对比相撞（用 versus）；一个变很多（用 clone-echo）；形状融成一个（用 sphere-merge）；单看认不出的部件；一部片用超过一两次。

pairs.note: in stream, over the night after the close, as the film's own ending
converge as the mascot's debut over the opening, its slam on the drop's landing

en: Hold the parts apart long enough to be recognised (about two beats from apart to the wind back): rushed, the slam merges two unread blurs.
The slam is the hit: give it the film's heaviest sound and let the music drop on it; the flash hides the cut to the whole, so the parts need not fit pixel for pixel.
In stream the shock is the line shooting across (`line`); on another look keep `impact` and let the roles reskin it, or turn the shake off on calm films.
zh: 两半分开后要停够让人认出来（从分开到蓄力约两拍）：太快的话扣合的是两团没看清的影子。
扣合是重拍：给它全片最重的声音，配乐在这里落下；闪白藏住切到整体那一下，两半不必逐像素拼准。
stream 里冲击就是线横穿画面（`line`）；别的样式保留 `impact`，靠颜色角色换皮，安静的片子把震屏关掉。

source.path: the stream films of the source production: the opening fusion and the closing reveal

overlaps.note: versus slams two sides of a comparison together and keeps them two (numbers, a stamp, a verdict); split-fuse shows one thing's parts and makes them one
clone-echo copies one element into many and draws them back into it (one is many); split-fuse takes one apart into two different parts and puts it back (what it is made of)
sphere-merge melts like shapes into one through a viscous neck; split-fuse slams two different pictures together and cuts to the whole under a flash

waive.all: an own brick from two stream films of the source production: no upstream shot; checked instead against both films at the same moments (card, Differs from upstream)
